title: docs(qa): three studio-authoring knownGaps quote the vitest invocation the ui guard accepts
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_

Fixes #28750

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：平台测试清单 `studio-authoring` 区里三个条目（对象设计器往返、记录页往返、权限矩阵编辑器）的 knownGaps[0]，把跑 jsdom 单测的命令改成 ui vitest 守卫接受的写法（`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 packages/PKG/src/FILE`），并注明旧的 `--filter` 写法会被拒绝；每个条目 revision +1、追加一行 history。第四个条目（打包自动化锁定）本来就是被接受的写法，未改动。
- 为什么改：旧命令在包目录里启动 vitest，守卫在加载配置时直接拒绝，一个测试都不跑。下一轮照着清单跑的人要么浪费时间找正确命令，要么把单测误记成 blocked(environment)。
- 风险与回滚：只改 QA 清单 JSON 里的说明文字，不动产品代码、不进任何发布包，没有任何判据被放宽。回滚就是 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` 中 `permission-matrix-editor-ux` 的 knownGaps[0] 与新 history 行（三处改动文字完全相同，看一处即可）。
- 两分钟验证：仓库根运行 `pnpm check:platform-checklist`，预期最后一行以 `check-platform-checklist: OK — 16 areas, 352 items` 开头。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` only. Three of the card's four items quoted `pnpm --filter @object-ui/PKG exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 FILE` for their jsdom unit pin. That command runs Vitest in the package directory, and `ui/scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs` (called from `ui/vitest.config.mts`) refuses any run whose Vitest root is not `ui/` (verdict `package-cwd`). Each of the three now carries, byte for byte, the sentence #28701 landed in `studio-authoring.expression-editors` knownGaps[1]: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 packages/PKG/src/FILE`, followed by the ⛔ note that the `--filter` form is refused and why.

| # | item · clause | outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `studio-authoring.object-designer-roundtrip` fixtures.knownGaps[0] | edited; revision 10 → 11, one history row |
| 2 | `studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip` fixtures.knownGaps[0] | edited; revision 11 → 12, one history row |
| 3 | `studio-authoring.permission-matrix-editor-ux` fixtures.knownGaps[0] | edited; revision 7 → 8, one history row |
| 4 | `studio-authoring.packaged-automation-studio-lock` fixtures.knownGaps[1] | not edited, no revision bump: it already quotes `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --root . --maxWorkers=2 FILE`, which the guard accepts (measured below) |

Each new history row cites #28656 (ref) and #28750, and says the change is wording only with no clause changed. Main's history is an exact prefix of each edited item's history, and no field other than `revision`, `history` and the one knownGaps string changed in any item (checked against a parsed copy of `HEAD` before the merge of `origin/main`).

## Tests

Docs only: no package source changes, so no build closure and no package test suite is owed. `skip-changeset`: the diff touches only `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json`, which no package ships.

The guard verdicts were measured two ways at this head:

- `evaluateVitestInvocation` from `ui/scripts/vitest-invocation-guard.mjs`, called directly: the new form (cwd `ui/`) is accepted; item 4's `--root .` form (cwd `ui/`) is accepted; the old `--filter` form (cwd `ui/packages/app-shell`) is refused with `package-cwd`.
- A real run of item 3's pin with the new form, under the verify lock: `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1 packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.fieldBulk.test.tsx` printed `RUN v4.1.12 .../ui`, `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 3 passed (3)`, lock VERDICT command-exit 0. The control, `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.fieldBulk.test.tsx`, exited 1 with the guard's package-cwd refusal (vitest root `ui/packages/app-shell`).

Every pin file the four items name under `ui/` exists at this head: `PermissionMatrixEditor.fieldBulk.test.tsx`, `.readonly.test.tsx`, `.artifactTier.test.tsx`, `StudioDesignSurface.automationsReadOnly-11124.test.tsx`, `ui/e2e/live/studio-object-designer.spec.ts`, `ui/e2e/live/studio-editor.spec.ts`.

## Acceptance notes

- Item 4 is left untouched because its command is an accepted form. Its explanatory sentence still says the `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell exec vitest run FILE` form "misses the ui/ setup". The measured behaviour today is a refusal at config load (package-cwd), not a run with the wrong setup. The command a runner copies is correct, so this is wording only and is left for the seat to decide.
- The landed sentence this PR mirrors starts its last clause with a lower-case "a ui/e2e/live spec" after a full stop. It is copied byte for byte so that the four knownGaps stay identical and greppable; not changed here.
- `meta-save-preconditions-and-draft-rows`, `multi-package-item-rows` and `save-door-runs-authoring-rules` quote `pnpm --filter PKG exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 FILE` in a verify. Their `automated.ref` files are all under `packages/` (backend packages), not `ui/`, so the ui guard does not apply; not touched.
